name: WP Engine Production Deploy
description: Deploys the theme to WP Engine production from a vX.Y.Z release tag — the tag release-please creates when its Release PR is merged. Waits for a completed pre-deploy restore point and refuses to deploy without one. Requires the WPE_SSHG_KEY_PRIVATE, WPE_API_USER_ID and WPE_API_PASSWORD secrets, the WPE_PROD_ENV variable and the BACKUP_NOTIFICATION_EMAIL variable. Pair with the Release Please template.
